uncertainties: Request count is observable from the fixed implementations; monetary cost, stable latency, availability, and long-run parser reliability were not compared.
A same-range live match does not authenticate NOAA, establish measurement validity, or support an emissions or causal claim.
The existing comparator can provide raw values as part of a broader result, but requires an extra page request that raw-only tasks do not need.

functional_findings: For the same 2023–2025 raw-only task, the new tool returned the three declared N2O values and uncertainties from one fixed raw-table GET. The existing N2O comparator used two requests and also returned the rendered-page values and comparison output.

The raw response digest and selected raw rows matched between the near-contemporaneous captures; the comparator additionally found an exact page/raw match for these three years. This is one matched observation, not long-run agreement or measurement validation.
The raw-only lookup is minimum-sufficient when the task needs only the fixed raw N2O table; it is insufficient when both current surfaces or their differences are required.
The existing CO2 and CH4 lookup/comparator tools have distinct fixed source species and remain useful; no existing candidate is replaced or retired.
